question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN 2024 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) >= 20 AND 2024 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) < 30 THEN '20s'
        WHEN 2024 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) >= 30 AND 2024 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) < 40 THEN '30s'
        WHEN 2024 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) >= 40 AND 2024 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) < 50 THEN '40s'
        WHEN 2024 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) >= 50 AND 2024 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) < 60 THEN '50s'
        ELSE 'others'
    END as age_category,
    COUNT(*) as user_count
FROM mst_users
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN 2024 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) >= 20 AND 2024 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) < 30 THEN '20s'
        WHEN 2024 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) >= 30 AND 2024 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) < 40 THEN '30s'
        WHEN 2024 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) >= 40 AND 2024 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) < 50 THEN '40s'
        WHEN 2024 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) >= 50 AND 2024 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) < 60 THEN '50s'
        ELSE 'others'
    END
ORDER BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN age_category = '20s' THEN 1
        WHEN age_category = '30s' THEN 2
        WHEN age_category = '40s' THEN 3
        WHEN age_category = '50s' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END
